title: Accounts Assistant
description:
The Opportunity
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an Accounts Assistant to join a busy finance team supporting multiple entities within a growing and dynamic business.

This is a varied role offering exposure across bookkeeping, month-end accounting, management information, VAT compliance and intercompany accounting. You'll work closely with the wider finance team, helping to ensure financial records are maintained accurately while supporting reporting and control processes across a portfolio of companies.

This position would suit an AAT-qualified individual or someone actively studying towards a professional accounting qualification who is looking to build on their existing finance experience and continue their career development.

The Role
Key Responsibilities
- Maintain accurate accounting records across multiple entities.
- Prepare and post journals, including accruals, prepayments and intercompany transactions.
- Raise sales invoices and process customer receipts.
- Support credit control activities and monitor outstanding balances.
- Perform bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies.
- Reconcile balance sheet control accounts and resolve reconciling items.
- Assist with the preparation of monthly management information.
- Support VAT reporting and compliance processes.
- Assist with year-end audit requirements and statutory reporting.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives across finance processes and controls.

The Person
About You
- AAT qualified or actively studying towards ACCA, CIMA or ACA.
- Previous experience in a finance or accounting role.
- Experience supporting month-end processes, including journals and reconciliations.
- Good understanding of double-entry bookkeeping and accounting principles.
- Strong Excel skills, including formulas, lookups and pivot tables.
- High attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
- Proactive approach with the ability to investigate and resolve issues.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to build relationships across the business.

Desirable Experience
- Experience within construction, property, housebuilding or project-based environments.
- Exposure to multi-entity or joint venture accounting.
- Experience of ERP/accounting systems and VAT compliance processes.
- Involvement in year-end audit and statutory reporting activities.

Why this role?
- Broad and varied finance role with significant exposure to month-end accounting.
- Opportunity to develop management accounting and reporting experience.
- Supportive and collaborative finance team.
- Study and development opportunities for those progressing professional qualifications.
- Strong opportunity to broaden your skillset across multiple areas of finance

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant & Payroll Coordinator

Location: Durham
Salary: £35,000+ DOE
Hours: 37.5 hours per week (Monday to Friday)
Working Hours: 8:00am-4:00pm, 8:30am-4:30pm, or 9:00am-5:00pm
Holiday: 25 days plus bank holidays (7 days reserved for Christmas shutdown)

My client is a successful and rapidly growing business that has recently expanded its operations with multiple new offices. They are looking to recruit a proactive and driven Accounts Assistant & Payroll Coordinator who can take ownership of key finance processes and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of the business.

This is a varied, hands-on position that will combine accounting, payroll and CIS responsibilities, while also providing the opportunity to become involved in month-end processes, VAT submissions and ongoing improvements across the finance function.

Key Responsibilities
- Process weekly/monthly payroll, ensuring all payroll data is accurate and submitted within agreed deadlines.
- Post and allocate bank transactions, maintaining accurate financial records across the finance systems.
- Process, review and validate supplier invoices, ensuring all costs are correctly coded and authorised.
- Process subcontractor invoices and maintain accurate CIS records.
- Prepare supplier payment runs and subcontractor payment schedules for approval and payment.
- Review employee expense claims, checking receipts and supporting documentation, maintaining expense records within Excel and preparing payment lists.
- Process employee expenses within Sage.
- Complete CIS reconciliations and ensure compliance with relevant regulations.
- Respond to payroll, supplier and subcontractor queries in a timely manner.
- Produce and maintain reports using Excel to support finance operations and decision-making.
- Support the development and improvement of finance processes, systems and reporting capabilities.
- Build strong working relationships with site teams and operational departments to ensure the smooth flow of payroll and expense information.
- Provide support and guidance to a junior member of the accounts team.

Month-End Responsibilities
- Complete bank reconciliations and investigate any outstanding variances.
- Perform payroll reconciliations to ensure accuracy between payroll and financial records.
- Post job costing and overhead allocations, including:
- Company vans
- Company cars
- Fuel costs
- Assist with the preparation of month-end accounts and management reporting.
- Support VAT return preparation and submissions.
- Produce travel expense analysis for Head Office.
- Reconcile supplier statements and investigate any discrepancies.
- Assist in maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring month-end deadlines are achieved.

About You
- Has experience within accounts and payroll
- Has CIS knowledge and experience
- Is confident using Excel and accounting systems such as Sage
- Can work independently and take ownership of processes

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity to join a business during an exciting period of growth. The role offers genuine responsibility, exposure to a broad range of finance activities and the chance to make a real impact on the development of the finance function while working as part of a close-knit and supportive team.

If you're interested, please submit your CV now!

title: Credit Controller
company: Paul Card Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
If you're the kind of Credit Controller who enjoys reducing aged debt, resolving queries and seeing the cash come in, this could be a rewarding temporary assignment.

We're recruiting a Temporary Credit Controller to support a growing business in the run-up to year-end.

Following a number of acquisitions, there's some historic debt that needs attention. Rather than simply sending standard reminders, you'll have the opportunity to get under the skin of the aged debtor report, understand what's holding up payment and improve the overall debtor position.

You'll be:

Investigating aged and historic debt
Chasing overdue balances and improving cash collection
Getting to the bottom of disputed invoices and outstanding queries
Reconciling accounts and resolving more complicated balances
Helping get the debtor ledger into better shape for year-end

If you're between roles, or simply looking for something temporary to take you through until Christmas, this could be an ideal opportunity to put your Credit Control experience to good use.

You'll need previous credit control experience and the confidence to pick up an aged ledger, understand what's sitting behind the numbers and start making progress without lots of hand-holding.

You'll be joining an existing finance team as an extra pair of experienced hands, so there'll be support around you while still giving you plenty to get your teeth into.

Like the sound of getting stuck into an aged ledger and seeing those overdue balances come down?

Apply now with your CV. If it's not up to date, don't worry. Get in touch with Natalie at Paul Card Recruitment for a confidential chat, send us your details or apply and we'll take it from there.
